spec.description: Metrics exposed by the sequencer client (aka sequencer connection) of participants and mediators: submission errors and overload, latency, request amplification and event processing

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, error) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_attempt_sync_errors_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Send attempts to a sequencer that were refused synchronously, e.g. SEQUENCER_OVERLOADED when the sequencer rate-limits the member, or SEQUENCER_MAX_SEQUENCING_TIME_TOO_FAR / RequestAlreadyExists. Counted per attempt, so amplified submissions can count once per sequencer.
spec.title: Synchronous submission errors by error

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($quantile, sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_sequencing_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description: Time from sending a submission to observing it sequenced (or timing out).
spec.title: Sequencing latency ($quantile)

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($quantile, sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_sends_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description: Time for the synchronous send call to return, including retries on synchronous errors.
spec.title: Send latency ($quantile)

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, sequencerAlias) (histogram_count(sum by (namespace, job, node, sequencerAlias) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_amplification_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))))

spec.description: Sequenced submissions by the sequencer of the last attempt, i.e. which sequencer actually got the submission sequenced. Shows how load is spread across sequencers.
spec.title: Sequenced submissions by sequencer

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_amplified_attempts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, job, node) (histogram_count(sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_sends_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))))

spec.description: Amplified attempts per submission. An attempt is amplified when it got no synchronous error but was not observed as sequenced within the amplification patience, so another sequencer is tried. Ideally close to 0; sustained values indicate slow or faulty sequencers.
spec.title: Amplification ratio

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, sequencerAlias) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_amplified_attempts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Attempts that timed out on the given sequencer (patience expired) and were re-sent to another sequencer. The sequencer label is the one that was too slow.
spec.title: Amplified attempts by sequencer

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($quantile, sum by (namespace, job, node, sequencerAlias) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_amplification_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description: Time from sending the last attempt of a submission to a sequencer until observing it sequenced. Only recorded for submissions that got sequenced. A single slow sequencer shows up here.
spec.title: Last attempt sequencing latency by sequencer ($quantile)

spec.expr: sum by (sequencerAlias) (increase(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_amplified_attempts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))

spec.description: Total amplified attempts per sequencer over the selected time range.
spec.title: Amplified attempts by sequencer (selected range)

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_handler_sequencer_events{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Events received from the sequencer subscription.
spec.title: Received events

spec.expr: max by (namespace, job, node) (daml_sequencer_client_handler_delay{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"})

spec.description: Delay between sequencing and processing of the last event. Growing delay means the node is falling behind.
spec.title: Sequencer delay

spec.expr: max by (namespace, job, node, sequencer) (daml_sequencer_client_handler_delay_per_connection{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"})

spec.description: Delay of receiving events over each sequencer connection.
spec.title: Delay per sequencer connection

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_attempt_sync_errors_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, job, node) (histogram_count(sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_sends_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))))

spec.description: Synchronous errors divided by submissions. Each refused attempt is retried, so this can exceed 100%. Anything sustained above a few percent means the sequencers are refusing a significant part of the load and submissions are being delayed by retries.
spec.title: Synchronous errors per submission

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($quantile, sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_handler_application_handle_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description: Time spent sequentially handling event batches in the node's application logic.
spec.title: Application handle latency ($quantile)

spec.expr: max by (namespace, job, node) (daml_sequencer_client_handler_actual_in_flight_event_batches{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"})
max by (namespace, job, node) (daml_sequencer_client_handler_max_in_flight_event_batches{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"})

spec.description: Event batches processed in parallel vs the configured upper bound.
spec.title: Event batches in flight

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_overloaded{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Send requests that received an overloaded response from the sequencer (submissions_overloaded).
spec.title: Overloaded responses

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, sequencerAlias, error) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_attempt_sync_errors_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Which sequencers are refusing submissions. Overload on a single sequencer points to that node, overload on all of them to the member exceeding the synchronizer-wide rate limit.
spec.title: Synchronous errors by sequencer

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_dropped{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Send requests that did not result in a sequenced event before their max sequencing time, i.e. the submission times out and has to be retried by the application.
spec.title: Dropped submissions

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, type) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_no_connection_available_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Send attempts skipped because no healthy sequencer connection was available.
spec.title: Attempts skipped, no connection available

spec.expr: histogram_count(sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_sends_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description: Send requests issued by the sequencer client (one per submission, before amplification).
spec.title: Submission rate

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, success) (histogram_count(sum by (namespace, job, node, success) (rate(daml_sequencer_client_submissions_amplification_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))))

spec.description: Submissions observed as sequenced, by outcome. success=false means the request was sequenced but rejected (e.g. insufficient traffic). Timed-out submissions are not counted here; see Dropped submissions.
spec.title: Sequenced submissions by outcome

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, type) (daml_sequencer_client_submissions_in_flight{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"})

spec.description: Sequencer submissions waiting for an outcome or timeout, by type. This is at the level of a sequencer submission, not a Daml transaction.
spec.title: In-flight submissions
Sequencer Client
